name: Discourse Mirror
summary: Copies a public Discourse forum into a ForkMesh repository's Forum tab, or into a repository of its own with offline pages, so mirrors keep it readable when the forum cannot be reached.

screenshots.alt: A mirrored forum's home page with categories, topics, post counts and the time of the last copy

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence. Mirrored posts stay their authors' under the source forum's terms.

permissions.label: Read the public topics, posts, categories and pictures of the forums you choose to copy
Write each forum's copy into a Git repository on this computer and commit it
Push the copy to the Git remote you name, so ForkMesh mirrors carry it
